decisions.reason: As a relatively low-visibility add-on to the established radiant-heater business it remains more droppable than the flagship lines, but another year of continued offering, a growing firm and market, and management’s tendency to justify prior investment still make retention more likely.

This multi-model electric infrared flagship is publicly tied to the firm’s broader lower-carbon building-climate direction, so accumulated investment, visible commitment, and the option to blame any weak uptake on temporary market adjustment strongly favor continuing it.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared line is highly central to the announced strategic future and was launched with a named real-world reference, so sunk costs, reputational commitment, and management’s strong need to validate the chosen path make withdrawal very unlikely.
